demos.title: Clear: eleven fish moving right
demos.summary: A busy but clear near-range recording with fish moving right. Compare the automatic counts with the CFC reference, and step through the tracks as they cross the line.

source.split_note: kenai-holdout-v1: a recording day never used for training or for choosing any setting

demos.title: Difficult: faint fish far from the sonar
demos.summary: A far-range recording where fish are small and faint, so the detector can miss them. Compare the automatic counts with the CFC reference; look for missed fish among the uncounted tracks and in the random audit windows, and add them with "Add missed fish here".

source.split_note: kenai-holdout-v1: a recording day never used for training or for choosing any setting

demos.title: Unfamiliar camera: the Kenai channel sonar
demos.summary: A camera the model never saw in training (an official CFC test location), with fish moving both ways. Compare the automatic counts with the CFC reference, and check each track's direction.

source.split_note: official test location kenai-channel, evaluated once for release passagewatch-0.3.0; never used for training or tuning
